## Checklist

- [ ] Commits follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) and are DCO signed off (`git commit -s`)
- [ ] Commits are cryptographically signed (SSH or GPG) and show as **Verified** on GitHub — see [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/CodeForFire/freizeichen/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#signing-your-commits)
- [ ] `make clean ci` passes locally
- [ ] UI changes include before/after screenshots; `make screenshots` re-run if a README view changed
- [ ] Dialling still goes through the confirm window, and numbers still reach the phone only through `TelUri`
- [ ] Screenshots, tests and examples use fictional phone numbers only
